# Data Codemap

> Generated: 2026-01-23

## Data Files

### scripts/pkglist.txt
Package source of truth, auto-updated by pacman hook.

```
# Format: one package per line
# Comments start with #
# Auto-generated header with timestamp

base-devel
git
neovim
...
```

### docs/gnome-extensions.md
Generated by `backup_gnome_state.sh`.

```
# One extension UUID per line
appindicatorsupport@rgcjonas.gmail.com
blur-my-shell@aunetx
...
```

### docs/gnome-appearrance.md
Generated by `backup_gnome_state.sh`.

```
# Format: <Type> <Theme>
Cursor Bibata-Modern-Classic
Icons Papirus-Dark
Shell Orchis-Dark
GTK Orchis-Dark
```

## Runtime Data (Git-Ignored)

### backups/
```
backups/
├── .gitkeep
├── gnome/
│   └── *.tar.gz    # Theme/extension archives
└── firefox/
    └── *.tar.gz    # Firefox profile archives
```

### configs/rime/*.userdb/
Rime input method user databases (build artifacts).

## State Files

### DPMS State (Runtime)
- `~/.cache/archpostinstall/dpms.state` - Current DPMS state
- `~/.cache/archpostinstall/dpms.log` - DPMS activity log

### Backup Hashes (Runtime)
- `~/.local/state/archpostinstall/themes.hash`
- `~/.local/state/archpostinstall/icons.hash`
- `~/.local/state/archpostinstall/extensions.hash`

## Data Flow

```
Pacman transaction
└── 99-update-pkglist.hook
    └── update_pkglist.sh
        └── scripts/pkglist.txt (updated)

GNOME config change
└── archpostinstall-gnome-sync.path (detects)
    └── backup_gnome_state.sh
        ├── docs/gnome-extensions.md (updated)
        ├── docs/gnome-appearrance.md (updated)
        └── backup_themes_extensions.sh (if hash changed)
            └── backups/gnome/*.tar.gz (created)

DPMS lock/unlock
└── archpostinstall-dpms-lock-monitor.service
    ├── dpms-toggle.sh --off (lock)
    │   ├── dpms.state (current state)
    │   └── dpms.log (activity)
    └── dpms-toggle.sh --on (unlock)
        ├── dpms.state (cleared)
        └── dpms.log (activity)
```
